snippet.title: Check Please - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Run chaotic medieval restaurants in this fantasy realm! Seat demanding magical creatures with your Demon Chef and serve over 100 unique dishes as you upgrade your taverns all across the kingdom! As the only human trapped in this fantasy medieval realm, your only way back to Earth is to wait tables.

Check Please will be available in Q4 2026!

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5011450/Check_Please/

Join the conversation on Discord: https://discord.gg/9mbbfzezdv

#gameannouncement #steamgame
